name: @pipeworx/mcp-poetrydb

tools.name: search_poems
tools.description: Search PoetryDB for poems by title or partial title (e.g., "The Road Not Taken"). Returns matching poems with full text, author, and line count. Note: searches titles only, not poem body text.

author.description: Author name or fragment, e.g. "Dickinson", "Shakespeare". Optional if title given.

title.description: Poem title or fragment, e.g. "Hope", "Sonnet". Optional if author given.

tools.name: get_poem_lines
tools.description: Full-text search within poem lines on PoetryDB — finds any poem containing the given phrase in one of its lines. Returns full poem text (capped). Keyless.

text.description: Phrase to find inside any line of a poem, e.g. "Nature", "the road not taken".

tools.name: random_poems
tools.description: Fetch one or more random public-domain poems from PoetryDB. Returns full poem text (capped). Keyless.

count.description: Number of random poems to return (default 1, max 10).

tools.name: list_authors
tools.description: List all authors available in PoetryDB. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-poetrydb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the poetrydb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
